channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Return to Riviera: Genesis Invitational field set for second signature event
item.description: The Genesis Invitational field features 18 of the 20 top-ranked golfers in the world, including defending champion Ludvig Åberg.

item.title: Taylor Swift rumors bring buzz, increase ticket sales at Pebble Beach
item.description: Taylor Swift boosted ticket sales to the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-am without even being there.

item.title: Kelce, Mitchell break out cashmere at Pebble Beach Pro-Am
item.description: NFL tight end Travis Kelce told Golf Channel's Todd Lewis that the game helps him get away from reality a bit during a walk-and-talk interview at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. Kelce said he was excited to be partnered with "Cashmere" Keith Mitchell, and said he's just trying to learn from the PGA Tour winner's style and swagger.

item.title: Keegan Bradley, Mary Meeker win pro-am portion of AT&T Pebble Beach
item.description: Keegan Bradley and Mary Meeker were wire-to-wire winners at the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. The Bradley-Meeker pairing led after 18 holes and held off a slew of competitors on Friday.

item.title: Spieth: 'I'd like it to be super pretty, sometimes it's not'
item.description: Jordan Spieth said during his second round in the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am that he was struggling, but he managed at 68 and is in the mix entering the weekend.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026: Round 3 tee times, groupings, and how to watch
item.description: Akshay Bhatia shares the lead with Ryo Hisatsune after 36 holes at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro Am. Here's how to watch Round 3 on Saturday.

item.title: Highlights: McIlroy puts on a show in Round 2 at Pebble
item.description: Rory McIlroy again made plenty of birdies (and an eagle) at the AT&T Pebble Beach. But a couple of hiccups has him playing catchup entering the weekend.

item.title: Highlights: Scheffler shows frustration early, rallies with 6-under 66
item.description: Scottie Scheffler was visibly upset throughout the first nine holes at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am Friday. Scheffler rallied with three birdies and an eagle on his back nine at Spyglass Hill and sets T-34 entering the weekend.

item.title: Akshay Bhatia, Ryo Hisatsune co-lead with tougher conditions looming at Pebble Beach
item.description: Bhatia and Hisatsune are tied at 15 under par with Rickie Fowler and Sam Burns one back. Mother Nature, however, might her say this weekend.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, Round 2
item.description: Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler each recorded eagles during the 2nd Round at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am but sit outside of the top 10 entering the weekend. Jordan Spieth is T-10 after firing a 4-under 68 Friday. Akshay Bhatia, who remains bogey free on the tournament, shares the lead with Ryo Hisatsune.
